description: This file manages message channel selection logic, including resolving channels, checking plugin configurations, and handling errors within an outbound channel selection module.

methods.name: isKnownChannel
methods.description: Checks if a given string value is a known deliverable message channel.

methods.name: resolveKnownChannel
methods.description: Resolves a string value to a known MessageChannelId if valid.

methods.name: resolveAvailableKnownChannel
methods.description: Resolves a known channel and verifies if the outbound plugin is configured for it.

methods.name: isAccountEnabled
methods.description: Determines if an account object is enabled based on its 'enabled' property.

methods.name: logChannelSelectionError
methods.description: Logs errors related to channel selection, avoiding duplicate logs.

methods.name: isPluginConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a channel plugin is properly configured and enabled for the current configuration.

methods.name: listConfiguredMessageChannels
methods.description: Lists all message channels that are configured and enabled.

methods.name: resolveMessageChannelSelection
methods.description: Resolves the message channel based on explicit, fallback, or default configuration, with error handling.
